aboutContent:
I am Harry Dong, a 2024-grade master student at the School of Computer Science, Nanjing Audit University.

My research interests include federated learning, federated graph learning, edge computing and privacy-preserving machine learning. My work focuses on data heterogeneity, noise robustness, communication efficiency and edge deployment under complex heterogeneous federated settings.
